title: CPT × Temporal-Folded SUSY research graph
description: A compact, versioned semantic layer for claims, evidence, sources, scopes, artifacts, and open problems. It records what was calculated without turning repository metadata into a physics verdict.

quick_answers.question: Did the bosonic parent work?
quick_answers.answer: Yes, in the scoped BGG (X,T,Y) kinetic block.

quick_answers.question: Did the specified strict off-shell FLRW SUSY truncation work?
quick_answers.answer: No; two independent normal-mode coefficients are nonzero at an exact clean point.

quick_answers.question: Can a standard local Q exchange t<0 and t>0 support?
quick_answers.answer: No; support locality makes both cross blocks zero.

quick_answers.question: What remains promising?
quick_answers.answer: A fundamental doubled-sheet algebra and a separate doubled-real projector witness exist, but their common action, domain, charge, and physical sheet anchor are open.

quick_answers.question: Does elapsed time itself break supersymmetry?
quick_answers.answer: No in the conserved-charge control: a Q-annihilated state remains Q-annihilated when [H,Q]=0.

quick_answers.question: Can one free instantaneous canonical seam explain missing superpartner pole masses?
quick_answers.answer: No in the frozen Phase 18 class. It can prepare a non-SUSY state, but the post-post retarded B/F poles remain degenerate and a sharp local kick has divergent energy density.

nodes.title: CPT × Temporal-Folded Supersymmetry

nodes.title: Support-local supercharge

nodes.title: Literal coordinate reflection
nodes.summary: The pullback R_t psi(t)=psi(-t), which exchanges time halves but reverses signed time momentum.

nodes.title: Physical time reversal
nodes.summary: The anti-complex-linear Wigner operation on states, distinct from the complex-linear coordinate pullback and from CPT/Pin sewing.

nodes.title: Fundamental doubled sheet
nodes.summary: An internal two-sheet Hilbert-space label on which a unitary sheet flip can multiply the ordinary supercharge.

nodes.title: Temporal seam reality
nodes.summary: Reality and projector conditions for a fixed t=0 seam, separated from spatial-boundary half-BPS constructions.

nodes.title: CPT/Pin sewing
nodes.summary: A bosonic discrete pairing or real structure between histories; it is not itself a complex-linear fermionic supercharge.

nodes.title: Schwinger–Keldysh BRST
nodes.summary: A topological contour-doubling algebra that encodes unitarity identities rather than particle superpartners.

nodes.title: Free canonical temporal seam
nodes.summary: An instantaneous standard Cauchy-data map at t=0 that preserves scalar symplectic flux or the finite-mode fermion CAR inner product while leaving future bulk operators unchanged.

nodes.title: Initial-state data versus spectral pole
nodes.summary: Occupation and anomalous Wightman data may change while a free post-post retarded commutator and its characteristic pole remain state independent.

nodes.title: Persistent SUSY-breaking carrier
nodes.summary: A nondecaying order parameter, memory sector, or vacuum selection mechanism required to convert a one-time seam event into permanent bulk soft terms.

nodes.title: P15R bosonic parent exists in the frozen census
nodes.statement: Inside the frozen Hohl/Kallosh two-source census, at least one single-source bosonic parent matches the target kinetic signature.
nodes.summary: Historical scoped target supported by Kallosh; it is not a literature-wide existence theorem.

nodes.title: P15R full off-shell parent exists in the frozen census
nodes.statement: Inside the frozen Hohl/Kallosh two-source census, a single parent supplies both the target bosonic sign and the required off-shell auxiliary/transformation coverage.
nodes.summary: Historical scoped target contradicted only inside the two-source census.

nodes.title: Literal opposite time branches are superpartners
nodes.statement: Opposite relational expanding and contracting branches are literal superpartners.
nodes.summary: Historical claim retained as inconclusive/unconstructed; Phase 17 tests sharper coordinate-time versions.

nodes.title: BGG supplies the target bosonic kinetic parent
nodes.statement: Under the stated BGG conventions and flat one-chiral W=0 specialization, the (X,T,Y) FLRW velocity block has inertia (1,0,2) and kinetic Hamiltonian N(-p_X^2+p_T^2+p_Y^2)/(2 V_0 a^3).
nodes.summary: Supported for the kinetic subblock; lapse and algebraic auxiliary constraints are outside this claim.

nodes.title: The specified strict off-shell FLRW truncation is SUSY-tangent
nodes.statement: The analyst-defined FLRW/gamma-trace locus with arbitrary homogeneous chi, chibar, F, and Fbar is preserved by the BGG local-SUSY transformations.
nodes.summary: Contradicted by exact nonzero b_i and spin-3/2 normal components at one clean point on the locus.

nodes.title: The scoped rolling chiral clock preserves a nonzero SUSY parameter
nodes.statement: On the bosonic W=0, F=0 slice with nonzero real proper-time scalar rate and Lorentzian-conjugate parameters, a nonzero local-SUSY parameter leaves the background invariant.
nodes.summary: Contradicted by a rank-two delta-chi parameter map; the underlying gauge symmetry is not removed.

nodes.title: A standard support-local Q exchanges the two coordinate-time halves
nodes.statement: A standard local 4D N=1 supercharge has a nonzero block from t>0 support to t<0 support, or conversely.
nodes.summary: Contradicted by support locality: both open-half cross blocks vanish.

nodes.title: Reflection-composed Q is a standard local conserved supercharge
nodes.statement: Composing a fixed-fiber supercharge with t-to-minus-t reflection preserves same-time locality and commutes with signed P_t.
nodes.summary: Contradicted: the finite fiber algebra passes, but the unfolded operator is nonlocal and anticommutes with signed time momentum.

nodes.title: A fundamental doubled sheet admits bidirectional SUSY exchange algebra
nodes.statement: On a fundamental two-sheet internal fiber, X_s tensor q_alpha preserves fixed-positive-energy N=1 closure and has nonzero rank-two cross blocks in both directions.
nodes.summary: Supported as a finite algebra witness; it is not evidence that bare coordinate-time halves realize the sheets.

nodes.title: A one-way sheet arrow preserves standard adjoint closure
nodes.statement: A one-way off-diagonal sheet charge can obey the unchanged standard N=1 physical-adjoint closure.
nodes.summary: Contradicted by the exact CAR block calculation.

nodes.title: The superalgebra uniquely selects the exchange basis
nodes.statement: Standard closure alone selects a unique local-versus-exchange sheet basis and mixing phase.
nodes.summary: Contradicted by a continuous unitary mixing family and parity-controlled basis equivalence.

nodes.title: A fixed temporal seam preserves an ordinary real SUSY subalgebra
nodes.statement: At a fixed t=0 seam, a nonzero Lorentzian-conjugate standard N=1 parameter closes tangent to the seam.
nodes.summary: Contradicted because v^0 is a positive sum of squares and vanishes only for the zero parameter.

nodes.title: A doubled real sheet-mixing projector witness exists
nodes.statement: Adding a real two-sheet complex structure yields a real rank-four temporal projector that mixes sheets.
nodes.summary: Supported only as a reality/projector witness; no Pin lift, action, domain, conserved charge, or observable follows yet.

nodes.title: Physical time reversal is itself the supercharge
nodes.statement: The antiunitary physical time-reversal operation can be identified with an ordinary complex-linear fermionic supercharge.
nodes.summary: Contradicted by complex antilinearity and grading; physical time reversal is a discrete operation, not the tested Q.

nodes.title: Schwinger–Keldysh BRST is particle supersymmetry
nodes.statement: The SK nilpotent contour charges directly pair physical bosons and fermions as 4D N=1 particle superpartners.
nodes.summary: Contradicted; the verified quartet is topological/ghost graded and its full contour metric remains unconstructed.

nodes.title: Elapsed time alone breaks supersymmetry
nodes.statement: For a conserved supercharge with [H,Q]=0, mere elapsed coordinate time can take a Q-annihilated state outside the Q kernel.
nodes.summary: Contradicted by the exact conserved-charge evolution control.

nodes.title: A free instantaneous canonical seam generates permanent B/F pole splitting
nodes.statement: With unchanged equal-mass free t>0 bulk operators, a finite instantaneous canonical Cauchy-data seam shifts the post-post retarded boson and fermion poles to unequal masses.
nodes.summary: Contradicted in the frozen class: both characteristic denominators remain p^2-m^2 and delta m_pole^2 is zero.

nodes.title: A free seam can prepare a non-SUSY state without moving the poles
nodes.statement: An explicit canonical scalar kick and finite two-mode fermion Nambu control can yield unequal B/F occupations while the common free retarded pole stays at m.
nodes.summary: Supported as a finite free-mode state witness; it is not a local fermionic Pin-sewing action.

nodes.title: The sharp spatially local scalar seam prepares a UV-admissible finite-energy state
nodes.statement: The delta-function scalar kick has finite continuum number and energy densities without temporal smoothing or UV completion.
nodes.summary: Contradicted: number density diverges linearly and energy density quadratically with the spatial cutoff.

nodes.title: Construct the Pin/Clifford lift
nodes.summary: Specify a source-defined reflection lift, square, cocycle, and Majorana bilinear.
nodes.question: Which Pin/Clifford lift and reflection cocycle make the doubled real projector a valid fermionic sewing structure?

nodes.title: Construct a doubled Lorentzian action
nodes.summary: Write one real quadratic bulk-plus-interface action for complete multiplets.
nodes.question: Can a real Lorentzian doubled bulk-plus-interface action realize the sheet structure?

nodes.title: Define the t=0 gluing domain
nodes.summary: Supply variationally admissible junction data and a self-adjoint common domain.
nodes.question: Which t=0 boundary data make the variational problem and operator domain well-defined?

nodes.title: Construct a conserved complex-linear fermionic charge
nodes.summary: The charge must act on the common domain and have a positive physical adjoint.
nodes.question: Does a conserved complex-linear fermionic charge exist on the doubled gluing domain?

nodes.title: Check projector-charge compatibility
nodes.summary: The doubled reality projector and the exchange charge have not been combined on one domain.
nodes.question: Does the sheet-mixing projector preserve the domain and intertwine the candidate charge?

nodes.title: Find a physical sheet anchor
nodes.summary: A basis-invariant observable must distinguish geometric sheets from an internal relabeling.
nodes.question: What physical observable anchors the sheet projectors and defeats the basis-equivalence null?

nodes.title: Complete reality, positivity, and junction data
nodes.summary: Majorana reality, positive inner product, and junction consistency remain unconstructed.
nodes.question: Can one choose reality and junction data compatible with positivity and causal evolution?

nodes.title: Complete the SK contour algebra
nodes.summary: The abstract quartet lacks a full contour operator algebra and ghost metric.
nodes.question: Can the full SK contour algebra and ghost metric be built without relabeling it as particle SUSY?

nodes.title: Construct the full 4D SUGRA interface
nodes.summary: No complete local-SUGRA interface, conserved seam charge, or anomaly-free constraint algebra has been built.

nodes.title: Compute interacting late-time Wigner self-energies
nodes.summary: The free pole theorem does not determine interacting state-dependent boson and fermion quasiparticle self-energies.
nodes.question: Do retarded Wigner self-energies in interacting Wess-Zumino theory approach unequal late-time quasiparticle poles after an admissible seam state?

nodes.title: Construct a persistent SUSY-breaking carrier
nodes.summary: A one-time free seam supplies no nondecaying bulk soft spurion or vacuum-selection mechanism.
nodes.question: Can a CPT/Pin-compatible seam select or source a finite-energy F/D order parameter that persists in the future bulk?

nodes.title: Compute FRW dilution and backreaction
nodes.summary: The reported a^-2 and a^-3 laws are collisionless conditional controls, not a solved cosmological evolution.
nodes.question: After expansion, interactions, thermalization, and backreaction, can any seam-induced SUSY-breaking medium effect survive to late times?

nodes.title: Compute the Higgs power sensitivity
nodes.summary: No Phase 18 calculation establishes cancellation of Standard Model Higgs quadratic sensitivity after seam breaking.
nodes.question: Does a consistent interacting doubled parent retain a regulator-independent boson/fermion UV cancellation while producing a non-SUSY observable spectrum?

nodes.title: Renormalization of initial conditions and the trans-Planckian problem of inflation

nodes.title: (Non) supersymmetric quantum quenches

nodes.title: Soft breaking of supersymmetry

nodes.citation: L. Girardello and M. T. Grisaru, Soft breaking of supersymmetry, Nuclear Physics B 194 (1982) 65-76

nodes.title: Two-sheeted universe, analyticity and the arrow of time
